scenario: 面试：设计一个自动售货机(投币 → 选商品 → 出货 → 找零)。
scenario_en: Interview: design a vending machine (insert money → select item → dispense → change).
q: 动手写类之前，最该先澄清哪组问题？
q_en: What should you clarify before writing classes?
options: 有哪些状态、状态间的合法转移、以及非法操作(未投币就选货)怎么处理
按钮用什么颜色、屏幕用什么字体渲染
机器外壳用什么材料、放在几楼
把每个阶段用一堆布尔标志位记录，再拿一大串 if 去判断当前在哪个阶段
options_en: Which states exist, the legal transitions between them, and how illegal actions (select before paying) are handled
What color the buttons are and what font the screen uses
What material the casing is and which floor it sits on
Track each phase with a pile of boolean flags and judge the current phase with a big chain of ifs
optionExplanations: 对：状态清单、合法转移、非法操作的处理——这三点直接决定你要不要用状态机、类怎么切。
错：渲染是 UI 细节，跟 OOD 无关。
错：物理外形不是这道 OOD 的核心。
错：一堆布尔标志 + 大 if 正是状态机要消灭的反模式。
optionExplanations_en: Right: the state list, legal transitions, and handling of illegal actions directly decide whether you need a state machine and how to split classes.
Wrong: rendering is a UI detail, unrelated to the OOD.
Wrong: physical shape is not the core of this OOD.
Wrong: a pile of boolean flags + a big if is exactly the anti-pattern a state machine removes.
why: OOD 先问清「有哪些状态、状态之间哪些转移合法、每个状态下非法操作怎么办」——这三点决定你把「阶段」建模成什么。售货机/ATM/红绿灯这类题的本质就是一台有限状态机。
why_en: Clarify the states, which transitions are legal, and what each state does on an illegal action — these decide how you model "phase". Vending machine / ATM / traffic light are all finite state machines at heart.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在任一时刻只处于有限个「状态」之一;外部事件触发从一个状态到另一个的「转移」;每个状态对同一事件可以有不同反应。售货机、ATM、红绿灯、TCP 连接都是 FSM
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A finite state machine (FSM): at any moment the system is in exactly one of a finite set of states; external events trigger transitions between states; the same event can behave differently per state. Vending machines, ATMs, traffic lights, and TCP connections are all FSMs.

scenario: 售货机在「空闲/已投币/出货中/售罄」下，对同一个动作反应各不相同。
scenario_en: The machine reacts differently to the same action while Idle / HasMoney / Dispensing / SoldOut.
q: 怎么组织这种「状态相关行为」最好？
q_en: What is the best way to organize this state-dependent behavior?
options: 每个状态做成一个类、实现同一 State 接口，机器持有当前状态对象并委托给它
在机器的每个方法里用一长串 if 判断「当前状态是哪个」，再逐一写出各分支的处理与转移
给每个状态一个全局布尔变量，靠它们的组合判断
为每一种「状态×动作」的组合各写一个顶层函数
options_en: Make each state a class implementing one State interface; the machine holds the current state and delegates to it
Inside every machine method, a long if-chain checks which state it is, then spells out each branch's handling and transition
Give each state a global boolean and judge by their combination
Write a separate top-level function for every state×action combination
optionExplanations: 对：这是状态模式——每状态一类、机器委托给当前状态对象;加状态=加一个类,不改老代码。
错：满屏 if state== 就是要消灭的东西,加状态就得改每个方法。
错：布尔组合会产生非法组合、且表达不了「行为」。
错：状态×动作矩阵爆炸,函数散落无处归属。
optionExplanations_en: Right: this is the State pattern — one class per state, the machine delegates to the current state object; adding a state = adding a class, not editing old code.
Wrong: if state== everywhere is what we remove; adding a state means editing every method.
Wrong: boolean combos allow illegal combinations and cannot express behavior.
Wrong: the state×action matrix explodes; functions scatter with no home.
why: 状态模式(State pattern):把「每个状态下的行为」封装进一个状态类,机器(context)只持有当前状态对象、把动作转发给它。好处:状态相关的逻辑各自归位、转移集中在状态类里、加状态不动老代码(OCP)。
why_en: State pattern: encapsulate the behavior of each state in a state class; the machine (context) just holds the current state object and forwards actions to it. Benefits: state-specific logic lives together, transitions are localized in state classes, adding a state does not touch old code (OCP).
tradeoff: 状态对象(每状态一类·易扩展·类多) vs 大 if/switch(集中·每加状态改所有方法)

termDefinitions.meaning: 把「随状态变化的行为」封装成一族状态类(实现同一接口),对象(context)持有当前状态、把请求委托给它;状态自己负责在合适时切换到下一个状态。效果是「看起来对象改变了自己的类」
termDefinitions.meaningEn: State pattern: encapsulate state-varying behavior into a family of state classes (one interface); the context holds the current state and delegates requests to it; a state switches the context to the next state itself. The object appears to "change its class" at runtime.

termDefinitions.meaning: 状态模式里持有「当前状态对象」的那个主体(这里=VendingMachine)。它不写状态相关逻辑,只保存共享数据(余额、库存)并把动作转发给当前状态
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In the State pattern, the context is the object that holds the current state (here = VendingMachine). It contains no state-specific logic; it just keeps shared data (balance, inventory) and forwards actions to the current state.

scenario: 你要定义所有状态都遵守的统一契约。
scenario_en: You must define the common contract all states obey.
q: State 接口应该长什么样？
q_en: What should the State interface look like?
options: 一个 State 接口，按「事件」为每个动作定义一个方法，每个具体状态各自实现自己的反应
一个 State 接口，只放一个 name 字段，不放行为
不要接口，每个状态类各写各的方法名
把所有事件塞进一个 handle(event) 大方法，内部再用 if 按 event 类型分派到不同处理
options_en: A State interface with one method per event; each concrete state implements its own reaction
A State interface holding only a name field, no behavior
No interface; each state class invents its own method names
Cram all events into one handle(event) method that internally ifs on the event type to route to different handling
optionExplanations: 对：按事件定义方法,机器就能对任意状态统一调用 state.select_item(...);每状态实现自己的反应。
错：只放 name 就退化成枚举,行为无处安放。
错：方法名不统一,机器没法统一委托。
错：handle(event) 内部再 if 事件,又把分派逻辑塞回一个方法。
optionExplanations_en: Right: one method per event lets the machine uniformly call state.select_item(...) on any state; each state implements its own reaction.
Wrong: only a name degenerates into an enum with nowhere for behavior.
Wrong: inconsistent method names mean the machine cannot delegate uniformly.
Wrong: handle(event) that ifs on the event pushes dispatch logic back into one method.
why: State 接口按「事件」列方法(insert_money、select_item、dispense…)。机器对当前状态统一调用同名方法,每个具体状态类给出自己的反应+决定转移到哪。这样机器代码与具体状态解耦。
why_en: The State interface lists one method per event (insert_money, select_item, dispense...). The machine calls the same method on whatever the current state is; each concrete state gives its own reaction and decides the next transition. This decouples machine code from concrete states.

scenario: VendingMachine 收到用户动作后该做什么。
scenario_en: What VendingMachine does when it receives a user action.
q: 机器(context)本身应该承担什么？
q_en: What should the machine (context) itself do?
options: 持有共享数据(余额/库存)和「当前状态」，把每个动作直接委托给当前状态对象
自己用一长串 if 判断当前处于哪个状态，并把所有状态的分支处理逻辑都写在机器内部
继承每一个具体状态类
把余额和库存分别塞进各个状态对象里各存一份
options_en: Hold shared data (balance/inventory) and the "current state", and delegate each action to the current state object
The machine uses a long if-chain to detect the current state and writes all states' branch logic inside itself
Inherit from every concrete state class
Store balance and inventory as separate copies inside each state object
optionExplanations: 对：context 只存共享数据 + 当前状态,动作一律转发;状态相关逻辑不在它这里。
错：又回到大 if,状态逻辑不该在 context。
错：context 组合状态,不继承。
错：数据应集中在 context 一份,状态无状态或只读它。
optionExplanations_en: Right: the context only stores shared data + the current state and forwards actions; state-specific logic is not here.
Wrong: back to a big if — state logic does not belong in the context.
Wrong: the context composes states, it does not inherit them.
Wrong: data lives once in the context; states are stateless or just read it.
why: context(VendingMachine)持有共享数据(余额、库存)和「当前状态对象」,提供 set_state() 让状态切换,把每个用户动作转发给当前状态。它自己不含状态相关分支——那些都在状态类里。
why_en: The context (VendingMachine) holds shared data (balance, inventory) and the current state object, exposes set_state() for transitions, and forwards each user action to the current state. It has no state-specific branches — those live in the state classes.

scenario: 空闲状态(IdleState)下用户投了币。
scenario_en: The user inserts money while in IdleState.
q: 状态转移在哪里发生、怎么发生？
q_en: Where and how does the transition happen?
options: 在具体状态方法内部：改共享数据，再调 machine.set_state(下一个状态)
由 context 在外面用一组条件判断该转到哪个状态，再统一设置 state，状态类完全不参与转移决定
用一个全局函数集中管理所有转移
让用户界面代码直接设置机器的状态字段
options_en: Inside the concrete state method: mutate shared data, then call machine.set_state(next state)
The context decides the next state from outside via conditionals and sets state centrally; state classes take no part in transitions
A single global function manages all transitions centrally
The UI code directly sets the machine's state field
optionExplanations: 对：当前状态最清楚「这个事件后该去哪」,所以它改数据后自己调 set_state 完成转移。
错：把转移判断塞回 context 又变大 if。
错：全局转移函数=另一处集中分派,失去封装。
错：UI 直接改状态字段会绕过规则、产生非法转移。
optionExplanations_en: Right: the current state best knows "where to go after this event", so after mutating data it calls set_state itself to transition.
Wrong: putting transition logic back in the context becomes a big if again.
Wrong: a global transition function is another central dispatch, losing encapsulation.
Wrong: the UI directly setting the state field bypasses rules and creates illegal transitions.
why: 转移由「当前状态」自己发起:在具体状态的事件方法里先更新共享数据,再调用 machine.set_state(下一个状态)。谁最懂这个事件后果,谁负责转移——这正是状态模式把转移逻辑分散到状态类的好处。
why_en: Transitions are initiated by the current state: inside the concrete state's event method, update shared data, then call machine.set_state(next state). Whoever best understands the event's consequence owns the transition — that is the State pattern spreading transition logic into state classes.

scenario: 用户在「出货中(Dispensing)」状态又投了一次币。
scenario_en: The user inserts money again while in the Dispensing state.
q: 这种「当前状态下不该发生的操作」怎么处理最好？
q_en: How should an action that is illegal in the current state be handled?
options: 由该状态自己的方法拒绝它(报错或忽略)，因为合法性依赖于「当前在哪个状态」
在 context 顶层写一个总的校验方法，用 if 集中检查所有「状态×动作」的非法组合
让所有状态默认接受任何操作，不做校验
崩溃退出，交给外层重启
options_en: The state's own method rejects it (error or ignore), because legality depends on which state you are in
Write one master validation method at the top of the context that ifs over every illegal state×action combination
Let all states accept any action by default with no validation
Crash and let the outer layer restart
optionExplanations: 对：一个操作合不合法取决于当前状态,所以让当前状态自己拒绝(抛错/忽略)最贴切、也最内聚。
错：顶层总 if 又把「状态×动作」矩阵集中,状态一多就爆炸。
错：默认全接受会产生非法转移(出货中还能再投币)。
错：崩溃是过度反应,非法操作是可预期的正常分支。
optionExplanations_en: Right: whether an action is legal depends on the current state, so letting the current state reject it (throw/ignore) is the most cohesive fit.
Wrong: a master if re-centralizes the state×action matrix and explodes as states grow.
Wrong: accepting everything by default creates illegal transitions (inserting money mid-dispense).
Wrong: crashing overreacts; an illegal action is an expected, normal branch.
why: 一个操作合不合法取决于当前状态(insert_money 在 Idle 合法、Dispensing 非法),所以让每个状态自己拒绝(抛 InvalidAction 或忽略),而非在一处集中判所有组合。
why_en: Judging an illegal action naturally belongs to the current state: the same insert_money is legal in Idle but illegal in Dispensing. So each state class implements "reject (throw InvalidAction or ignore) unsupported actions" rather than centralizing all combinations. A default "reject" in the State base class, overridden only for supported events, keeps it terse.

scenario: 余额、库存这些数据该放哪。
scenario_en: Where should data like balance and inventory live.
q: 共享数据应该放在哪里？
q_en: Where should shared data live?
options: 放在 context 里一份，状态对象保持无状态，需要时读写 machine 上的数据
每个状态对象各存一份余额和库存的副本
用一堆全局变量存余额和库存
把余额存在 Idle 状态里、库存存在 Dispensing 状态里，用到时再跨状态互相去取
options_en: Once in the context; state objects stay stateless and read/write data on the machine when needed
Each state object keeps its own copy of balance and inventory
Store balance and inventory in a bunch of global variables
Keep balance in the Idle state and inventory in the Dispensing state, reaching across states to fetch them when needed
optionExplanations: 对：共享数据集中在 context 一份,状态对象无状态、可随意 new/替换,不会出现多份不一致。
错：多份副本必然不一致,切状态就丢数据。
错：全局变量破坏封装、难测、不可复用。
错：把共享数据拆散进各状态,读写要跨状态,极其混乱。
optionExplanations_en: Right: shared data lives once in the context; state objects stay stateless and can be freely created/swapped with no inconsistent copies.
Wrong: multiple copies drift out of sync; switching states loses data.
Wrong: globals break encapsulation, hurt testing, and block reuse.
Wrong: scattering shared data across states forces cross-state reads/writes — chaos.
why: 职责分工(SRP):context 存共享数据(余额、库存),状态对象只封装「行为+转移」、尽量无状态。这样状态对象能随手 new/替换、能被复用,数据也只有一份不会不一致。
why_en: Separation of responsibility (SRP): the context holds shared data (balance, inventory); state objects encapsulate only behavior + transitions and stay stateless. State objects can then be freely created/swapped and reused, and there is a single copy of data with no drift.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单一职责原则:一个类只负责一件事、只有一个「变更的理由」。这里 context 负责「存数据+持有状态」,每个状态类负责「该状态下的行为+转移」,各司其职
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Single Responsibility Principle: a class does one thing and has one reason to change. Here the context owns "hold data + current state", each state class owns "behavior + transition for that state".

scenario: 面试官问：状态少的时候，非得上状态模式吗？
scenario_en: Interviewer asks: with few states, must you use the State pattern?
q: 「枚举+switch」和「状态对象」怎么权衡？
q_en: Enum+switch vs state objects — how to weigh them?
options: 状态少、转移简单时枚举+switch 够用；状态多、行为复杂、常加状态时状态对象更清晰
任何情况都必须用状态对象，枚举是错的
两者完全等价，随便选哪个都行
无论状态多少，枚举+switch 都更好，状态模式在这类题里纯属过度设计、只会徒增类数量
options_en: Enum+switch is fine when states are few and simple; state objects are clearer when states are many, behavior complex, or states added often
You must always use state objects; enums are wrong
They are exactly equivalent, pick either at random
No matter how many states, enum+switch is always better; the State pattern here is pure over-engineering that just multiplies classes
optionExplanations: 对：这是个规模权衡——小状态机用枚举+switch 更省;状态/行为一多,状态对象把每态逻辑分离、加状态不改老代码。
错：小状态机上状态模式反而是过度设计。
错：可维护性、扩展成本明显不同,不等价。
错：状态一多 switch 会变巨兽、每加状态改所有 switch。
optionExplanations_en: Right: it is a scale tradeoff — small machines are cheaper with enum+switch; as states/behavior grow, state objects separate per-state logic and adding a state avoids editing old code.
Wrong: for a tiny machine the State pattern is over-engineering.
Wrong: maintainability and extension cost clearly differ; not equivalent.
Wrong: with many states the switch becomes a monster and every new state edits all switches.
why: 权衡看规模:①状态少、转移简单、行为轻 → 枚举 + switch/字典转移表 最省;②状态多、每态行为复杂、要频繁增删状态 → 状态对象(把每态逻辑各自封装、加状态=加类)。面试能说清「什么时候不该上状态模式」是加分项。
why_en: The tradeoff is about scale: (1) few states, simple transitions, light behavior → enum + switch / a dict transition table is cheapest; (2) many states, complex per-state behavior, frequent add/remove → state objects (encapsulate each state, adding a state = adding a class). Saying when NOT to use the State pattern scores points.
tradeoff: 枚举+switch(小状态机·集中·省代码) vs 状态对象(大状态机·分离·加状态不改老代码)

termDefinitions.meaning: 用数据(字典/二维表)表示「(当前状态,事件)→下一个状态」的映射,而不是用代码分支。适合状态多但每态行为简单、转移规则规整的场景;行为复杂时仍需状态对象承载逻辑
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transition table encodes "(current state, event) → next state" as data (a dict/2-D table) instead of code branches. Good when states are many but per-state behavior is simple and transitions are regular; complex behavior still needs state objects to carry logic.

scenario: 换成设计 ATM(插卡 → 输 PIN → 选操作 → 取钞 → 退卡)。
scenario_en: Now design an ATM (insert card → enter PIN → choose op → dispense cash → eject card).
q: ATM 用同一套状态机骨架，状态大致是？
q_en: Using the same state-machine skeleton, what are the ATM states?
options: NoCard→HasCard→Authenticated→…→OutOfService，同样是每状态一类、机器委托
在一个大 while 循环里用一个 step 计数器判断当前走到第几步，再用一长串 if 分派每一步该执行什么操作、如何跳转
把插卡、验证、取钞写成三个互不相关的脚本
不需要状态，直接按钮按下就执行对应函数
options_en: NoCard→HasCard→Authenticated→…→OutOfService; again one class per state, the machine delegates
One big while loop with a step counter judging which step you reached, then a long if-chain routing what each step does and where it jumps
Write insert-card, verify, dispense as three unrelated scripts
No states needed; each button press just runs its function
optionExplanations: 对：ATM 只是换一组状态(NoCard/HasCard/Authenticated…),骨架完全照搬售货机——这就是「原型可迁移」。
错：step 计数器又是伪状态机,非法操作无处拦。
错：三个独立脚本丢掉了「当前处于哪一步」的约束。
错：无状态会让「没验证就取钞」这类非法操作漏过。
optionExplanations_en: Right: the ATM just swaps in a new set of states (NoCard/HasCard/Authenticated...); the skeleton copies the vending machine — the archetype transfers.
Wrong: a step counter is a fake state machine with nowhere to block illegal actions.
Wrong: three separate scripts lose the "which step am I in" constraint.
Wrong: no states lets illegal actions like "dispense before auth" slip through.
why: ATM 和售货机是同一个状态机原型:只是状态换成 NoCard→HasCard→Authenticated→SelectingTxn→Dispensing→退卡,以及 OutOfService。State 接口按事件(insert_card、enter_pin、select、dispense、eject)定义,机器委托当前状态、状态自转移。认出「这是状态机」比记住某道题更值钱。
why_en: The ATM is the same state-machine archetype: only the states change to NoCard→HasCard→Authenticated→SelectingTxn→Dispensing→eject, plus OutOfService. The State interface is defined by events (insert_card, enter_pin, select, dispense, eject); the machine delegates and states self-transition. Recognizing "this is a state machine" is worth more than memorizing one problem.

scenario: 换成红绿灯：红→绿→黄→红 自动循环，没有用户操作。
scenario_en: Now a traffic light: red→green→yellow→red cycling automatically, no user action.
q: 没有用户事件，状态模式还适用吗？转移由谁触发？
q_en: With no user events, does the State pattern still fit? What triggers transitions?
options: 仍适用：转移由「定时器到期」这个事件触发，每个灯态知道自己该亮多久、下一个是谁
不适用，状态模式只能处理用户点击
把三个灯的开关直接写死成一段固定的 sleep 序列：红睡几秒切绿、绿睡几秒切黄，如此循环
需要为每一秒各建一个状态类
options_en: Still fits: transitions are triggered by a "timer expired" event; each light state knows its own duration and who is next
Does not fit; the State pattern only handles user clicks
Just hard-code the three lights as a fixed sleep sequence: red sleeps then green, green sleeps then yellow, and loop
You need one state class per second
optionExplanations: 对：触发源可以是定时器/传感器,不必是用户;每个灯态封装「亮多久 + 下一个状态」,tick 到点就转移。
错：状态模式对「事件来源」不挑,定时器也是事件。
错：写死 sleep 序列不可配置、加行人按钮就崩。
错：状态是「灯的阶段」,不是「秒」,别把时间当状态。
optionExplanations_en: Right: the trigger can be a timer/sensor, not only a user; each light state encapsulates "duration + next state" and transitions when the tick fires.
Wrong: the State pattern is agnostic to the event source; a timer is an event.
Wrong: a hard-coded sleep sequence is not configurable and breaks when a pedestrian button is added.
Wrong: states are "light phases", not "seconds" — do not model time as states.
why: 状态机的「事件」不必来自用户——定时器到期、传感器也是事件。红绿灯每个灯态封装「时长 + 下一个状态」,tick 到点就 set_state 转移;加行人按钮=加事件/状态,骨架不变。
why_en: A state machine's "events" need not come from users — a timer firing or a sensor is an event. Each light state encapsulates "duration + next state"; a tick()/timer expiry calls set_state to transition. This shows the State pattern is for event-driven systems, not only user-driven ones. Adding a pedestrian button = adding an event/state; the skeleton is unchanged.
tradeoff: 定时器驱动的状态机(可配时长·可加行人事件) vs 写死 sleep 序列(简单·不可扩展)

scenario: 面试官追问：新加一个「维护中」状态，改动面有多大？
scenario_en: Follow-up: adding a "Maintenance" state — how large is the change?
q: 在状态对象设计里加一个新状态，通常要动什么？
q_en: In the state-object design, what usually changes to add a new state?
options: 新增一个 MaintenanceState 类，并在转入它的那几个状态里加一句 set_state
修改每一个已有状态类的所有方法
重写 VendingMachine 的全部逻辑
改动 State 接口、给它加一个新方法，结果被迫回头逐一修改所有已有状态类去实现它，否则编译不过
options_en: Add a MaintenanceState class and one set_state call in the few states that transition into it
Edit every method of every existing state class
Rewrite all of VendingMachine's logic
Change the State interface by adding a method, forcing you to go back and edit every existing state class to implement it or it won't compile
optionExplanations: 对：加状态=加一个类,只在「会转入它」的少数状态里加一处转移;其余状态和 context 不动(OCP)。
错：不相关的状态不该被牵连修改。
错：context 只委托,加状态跟它无关。
错：加状态一般不改接口(除非引入了全新事件)。
optionExplanations_en: Right: adding a state = adding a class, with one transition added only in the few states that lead into it; other states and the context are untouched (OCP).
Wrong: unrelated states should not be dragged into the change.
Wrong: the context only delegates; adding a state does not involve it.
Wrong: adding a state usually does not change the interface (unless a brand-new event appears).
why: 加状态成本很低:新增一个 MaintenanceState 类 + 在会转入它的少数状态里加一句 set_state,其余状态、context、接口都不动(OCP)。这正是状态模式在状态频繁增长时的价值。
why_en: Extension cost in the state-object design is low: adding "Maintenance" = a new MaintenanceState class + one set_state(MaintenanceState()) in the few states that lead into it. Unrelated states, the context, and the interface stay put. Contrast enum+switch, where every switch may need a new case. That is the State pattern's payoff when states grow often.

scenario: 复盘状态机类 OOD 的常见失分点。
scenario_en: Review common mistakes on state-machine OOD.
q: 下面哪些是常见设计错误？（多选）
q_en: Which are common design mistakes here? (multi-select)
options: 每个方法里都写一大串 if 当前状态==... 的分支
把余额、库存等共享数据在每个状态对象里各存一份
允许外部代码直接改机器的 state 字段、绕过合法转移
每个状态一个类、实现统一 State 接口、由当前状态自己发起转移
options_en: Writing a big chain of if current_state == ... in every method
Storing shared data like balance/inventory as a separate copy in each state object
Letting external code set the machine's state field directly, bypassing legal transitions
One class per state implementing a common State interface, with the current state initiating transitions
optionExplanations: 错误:满屏 if state== 就是状态模式要消灭的;加状态得改每个方法。
错误:多份数据副本必然不一致,状态对象应无状态、共享数据放 context。
错误:外部直接设 state 会产生非法转移,转移应只经受控入口(状态内 set_state)。
这是对的:接口 + 每状态一类 + 状态自转移,正是状态模式正解。
optionExplanations_en: Mistake: if state== everywhere is exactly what the State pattern removes; adding a state edits every method.
Mistake: multiple data copies drift; state objects should be stateless with shared data in the context.
Mistake: setting state directly from outside creates illegal transitions; transitions should go through a controlled path (set_state from within states).
This is correct: interface + one class per state + self-transition is the right State-pattern answer.
why: 三个坑:①每个方法一大串 if state==(伪状态机)②共享数据在每状态各存一份(不一致)③外部直接改 state 绕过合法转移。正解=State 接口 + 每状态一类 + 数据放 context + 状态自转移。
why_en: Three pitfalls: (1) a big if state== in every method (fake state machine; adding a state edits everything); (2) shared data copied into each state (drift); (3) external code setting the state field directly, bypassing legal transitions (illegal states). The fix: a State interface + one class per state + shared data in the context + transitions initiated by the current state via set_state.
tradeoff: 伪状态机/散落的 if(集中·加状态改所有方法) vs 状态对象(分离·加状态只加类)

scenario: Follow-up：两个用户(或多线程)同时操作售货机，怎么保证不出错？
scenario_en: Follow-up: two users (or threads) operate the machine at once — how do you keep it correct?
q: 最稳妥的并发处理思路是？
q_en: What is the soundest approach to concurrency?
options: 识别临界区(库存扣减、余额、状态转移)各用原子操作或锁保护，进入 Dispensing 即锁住其它输入
给整个 VendingMachine 的每个方法都套上一把全局大锁，把所有调用不分场景地强制串行化处理
不用处理并发，一台售货机同一时刻反正只有一个人在用
开多个线程并行处理同一笔交易来提高吞吐
options_en: Identify critical sections (inventory decrement, balance, transitions), guard each with atomics/locks; lock other inputs once in Dispensing
Put one global lock around every single method of the whole VendingMachine and force-serialize all calls regardless of context
No concurrency handling needed; only one person uses a machine at a time anyway
Spawn multiple threads to process the same transaction in parallel for throughput
optionExplanations: 对：售货机本质单会话，只锁关键的库存/余额/状态转移(细粒度)即可，出货中拒绝其它输入。
错：一把大锁能对但太粗，扼杀并发、还易死锁；面试要的是「指出临界区」。
错：物理上或许一人用，但库存和钱是共享状态，多机/补货线程仍会并发。
错：一笔交易并行只会制造竞态，不是提速的正确场景。
optionExplanations_en: Right: the machine is single-session; guard only the key inventory/balance/transition (fine-grained) and reject other inputs mid-dispense.
Wrong: one big lock is correct but too coarse — kills concurrency and risks deadlock; the interview wants you to name the critical section.
Wrong: physically maybe one user, but inventory and money are shared state; multi-machine/restock threads still race.
Wrong: parallelizing one transaction just creates races, not speed.
why: 售货机本质单会话。答题关键是「指出临界区」:库存扣减要原子(compare-and-decrement/行锁/Redis DECR，防超卖)、扣款与出货要事务化、进入 Dispensing 就锁其它输入——而不是给整个类加一把大锁。ATM 天然一卡一 session、串行。
why_en: The machine is single-session. The key is naming the critical section: inventory decrement must be atomic (compare-and-decrement/row lock/Redis DECR to prevent oversell), charge+dispense must be transactional, and other inputs are locked once in Dispensing — not one big lock on the whole class. An ATM is naturally serial: one card, one session.
tradeoff: 细粒度锁临界区(并发好·要想清楚) vs 一把大锁(简单·扼杀并发/易死锁)

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个线程/请求会同时访问、且必须互斥进入的那段共享数据/代码(这里=库存、余额、状态转移)。并发设计的第一步是「找出临界区」再针对性保护,而不是给整个对象加一把大锁
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A critical section is the shared data/code that multiple threads may access concurrently and must enter mutually exclusively (here: inventory, balance, transitions). Concurrency design starts by identifying it and guarding it specifically, not locking the whole object.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个请求同时读到「还剩 1 件」,各自都以为买得到、都扣减,结果卖出 2 件。根因是「读-判断-扣减」非原子;解法是原子扣减(compare-and-decrement/行锁/DECR)
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Oversell: two requests both read "1 left", each thinks it can buy and decrements, so 2 are sold. Root cause is a non-atomic read-check-decrement; the fix is atomic decrement (compare-and-decrement/row lock/DECR).

scenario: Follow-up：现在要支持刷卡和扫码支付，怎么改？
scenario_en: Follow-up: now support card and QR payment — how do you change it?
q: 最符合开闭原则的做法是？
q_en: What best fits the Open/Closed Principle?
options: 定义 PaymentMethod 接口(pay→结果)，每种支付一个实现类，机器依赖接口而非具体支付
在机器里到处加 if payment_type=="card"/"qr" 的分支判断，每新增一种支付都回来改这段代码
为刷卡和扫码各复制一份 VendingMachine 类
把三种支付的逻辑直接写死在 HasMoney 状态里
options_en: Define a PaymentMethod interface (pay→result), one class per method; the machine depends on the interface, not concrete payments
Add if payment_type=="card"/"qr" branches all over the machine and come back to edit them for every new payment method
Copy a separate VendingMachine class for card and for QR
Hard-code all three payment logics inside the HasMoney state
optionExplanations: 对：支付=一族可互换策略(Strategy)，机器依赖 PaymentMethod 接口(依赖倒置)，加支付=加类,状态机不动。
错：到处 if payment_type 就是每次加支付都改老代码,违反 OCP。
错：复制整个类是最坏的重复,DRY 全废。
错：把支付写死进状态耦合太紧,换支付要改状态。
optionExplanations_en: Right: payments are interchangeable strategies; the machine depends on the PaymentMethod interface (dependency inversion). Add a payment = add a class; the state machine is untouched.
Wrong: if payment_type everywhere means editing old code per new payment — breaks OCP.
Wrong: copying the whole class is the worst duplication, killing DRY.
Wrong: hard-coding payments into a state couples too tightly; swapping payments edits the state.
why: 在 State 之外再叠一个 Strategy + 依赖倒置:定义 PaymentMethod 接口(pay(amount)→PaymentResult),CoinPayment/CardPayment/QRPayment 各实现,机器依赖接口不依赖具体支付。加一种支付=加一个类,状态机骨架不动(OCP)。支付结果驱动转移:成功→Dispensing,失败→退回 HasMoney。
why_en: Layer Strategy + dependency inversion on top of State: define a PaymentMethod interface (pay(amount)→PaymentResult); CoinPayment/CardPayment/QRPayment each implement it; the machine depends on the interface, not concretes. Adding a payment = adding a class; the state machine is untouched (OCP). The result drives the transition: success→Dispensing, failure→back to HasMoney.

termDefinitions.meaning: 高层模块(VendingMachine)不依赖低层具体实现(CardPayment),两者都依赖抽象(PaymentMethod 接口)。这样换/加实现不动高层。它是「面向接口编程」的原则化表述
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dependency Inversion Principle: high-level modules (VendingMachine) do not depend on low-level concretes (CardPayment); both depend on an abstraction (the PaymentMethod interface). Swapping/adding implementations leaves the high level untouched — the principled form of "program to an interface".

scenario: Follow-up：出货到一半断电了，重启后怎么办？
scenario_en: Follow-up: power is lost mid-dispense — what happens on restart?
q: 怎么保证既不吞钱也不重复出货？
q_en: How do you avoid both swallowing money and double-dispensing?
options: 把关键状态和交易持久化，出货做成幂等两阶段(先记待出货、出完才标 done)，重启按记录补出或退款
每一笔交易都必须先等远端服务器同步确认成功，确认不到就让整机彻底停摆、拒绝一切交易，直到网络恢复为止
全放内存，断电就当无事发生、让用户重新投币
假设断电很少发生，不做任何处理
options_en: Persist key state and the transaction; make dispense idempotent in two phases (record "pending", mark done only after); on restart, re-dispense or refund per the record
Every transaction must first await synchronous confirmation from a remote server; if none comes, halt the whole machine and refuse all transactions until the network returns
Keep everything in memory; on power loss pretend nothing happened and make the user re-insert money
Assume power loss is rare and do nothing
optionExplanations: 对：本地持久化关键状态 + 出货幂等两阶段,重启看到「待出货」就补出或退款——不吞钱不重复。
错：把出货耦合到网络可用性,断网就瘫;售货机必须能离线工作,恢复该靠本地持久化。
错：只放内存,断电即丢,用户已扣款却什么都没拿到。
错：断电是可预期故障,忽略它就是设计缺陷。
optionExplanations_en: Right: persist key state locally + two-phase idempotent dispense; on restart a "pending" record triggers re-dispense or refund — no swallow, no double.
Wrong: coupling dispense to network availability halts on outage; the machine must work offline and recover from local persistence.
Wrong: memory-only loses everything on power loss; the user is charged but gets nothing.
Wrong: power loss is an expected fault; ignoring it is a design flaw.
why: 两点:①持久化关键状态——把(当前状态,余额,正在出的商品,是否已扣款)写进 NVRAM/DB,上电恢复到断点,别只放内存。②出货做成幂等两阶段:先记「已扣款·待出货」意图,出完才标 done;重启看到「待出货」就补出或退款。跟 bulk-email-move 的断点续跑/幂等同一套思路。
why_en: Two things: (1) persist key state — write (current state, balance, item being dispensed, charged?) to NVRAM/DB and resume on power-up, not memory-only; (2) two-phase idempotent dispense — record "charged, pending" first, mark done only after; on restart a "pending" record re-dispenses or refunds. Same idea as bulk-email-move resume/idempotency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一操作执行一次和执行多次效果相同。出货记录一个「已扣款·待出货」意图 + 用交易号去重,重启后重放不会重复出货或重复扣款。是崩溃恢复/重试安全的基石
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotency: performing the same operation once or many times yields the same effect. Recording a "charged, pending" intent + deduping by transaction id means a restart replay neither double-dispenses nor double-charges. It is the basis of crash-recovery/retry safety.

scenario: Follow-up：一个城市 1000 台售货机，要中央看板和自动补货，架构怎么变？
scenario_en: Follow-up: 1000 machines in a city, a central dashboard and auto-restock — how does the architecture change?
q: 从单机 OOD 扩到这个规模，合理的演进是？
q_en: From single-machine OOD to this scale, what is a reasonable evolution?
options: 每台本地跑状态机，库存/销售事件经消息队列上报中央聚合，价格与商品从中央下发
让 1000 台机器全部直连同一个中央数据库，每一次投币和出货都同步读写这个共享库
把所有机器的状态机都跑在一台中央服务器上，机器只当哑终端
每台机器各自为政，不做任何上报和同步
options_en: Each machine runs its state machine locally; inventory/sales events go to a queue for central aggregation; prices/items are pushed from central
Have all 1000 machines connect directly to one central database and synchronously read/write it on every insert and dispense
Run every machine's state machine on one central server; machines are dumb terminals
Every machine goes it alone with no reporting or sync
optionExplanations: 对：机器本地自治(能离线)+事件上报中央聚合,是边缘/中心的标准演进;VendingMachine 类基本不变,只多组合一个上报器。
错：千台直连同库、每步同步读写=巨大瓶颈+单点,断网就全停。
错：状态机跑中央、机器当哑终端,断网机器就不能卖,违背就近自治。
错：完全不同步就没有中央看板和补货,答非所问。
optionExplanations_en: Right: locally autonomous machines (work offline) + event reporting to central aggregation is the standard edge/center evolution; VendingMachine barely changes, just composes a reporter.
Wrong: 1000 machines on one DB with synchronous per-step read/write is a huge bottleneck and single point; an outage stops everything.
Wrong: running the state machine centrally with dumb terminals means no selling during an outage, breaking local autonomy.
Wrong: no sync means no dashboard or restock — it does not answer the question.
why: LLD 升 HLD:每台机器本地跑状态机(边缘节点、能离线)→库存/销售事件经消息队列上报中央→中央聚合看板、触发补货工单;价格/商品从中央下发。VendingMachine 类基本不变,只是组合进一个 EventReporter/SyncClient。面试官在探你能否把 class design 接到 system design。
why_en: LLD to HLD: each machine runs its state machine locally (edge node, works offline) → inventory/sales events go via a queue to central → central aggregates the dashboard and triggers restock orders; prices/items are pushed down. VendingMachine barely changes, just composes an EventReporter/SyncClient. The interviewer probes whether you can connect class design to system design.
tradeoff: 本地自治+异步上报(可离线·最终一致) vs 千台直连中央库同步读写(强一致·单点瓶颈)

scenario: Follow-up：VendingMachine 应该做成单例(Singleton)吗？
scenario_en: Follow-up: should VendingMachine be a Singleton?
q: 最成熟的回答是？
q_en: What is the most mature answer?
options: 一台机器逻辑上一个实例，但是否用 Singleton 取决于部署；我倾向依赖注入一个实例，便于测试
必须用单例——全局只能存在一个 VendingMachine 实例，无论单元测试还是多机部署都强制唯一
绝不能用单例，单例在任何设计里都是反模式
无所谓，随便 new 多少个 VendingMachine 都行
options_en: One machine is logically one instance, but whether to use Singleton depends on deployment; I prefer injecting a single instance for testability
Must use Singleton — only one VendingMachine may exist globally, forced unique whether unit-testing or deploying many machines
Never use Singleton; it is an anti-pattern in every design
Does not matter; new as many VendingMachines as you like
optionExplanations: 对：区分「逻辑唯一」和「Singleton 模式」;用 DI 注入一个实例既保证唯一又可测/可多机模拟——比死记「用单例」成熟。
错：强制全局单例会挡住单元测试和「一个进程模拟多台机器」。
错：一棍子打死太绝对,单例在合适场景仍有用。
错：随便 new 多个会让共享状态(库存/余额)分裂、不一致。
optionExplanations_en: Right: separate "logically unique" from "the Singleton pattern"; injecting one instance gives uniqueness AND testability/multi-machine simulation — more mature than reflexively "use Singleton".
Wrong: a forced global singleton blocks unit tests and "one process simulating many machines".
Wrong: a blanket ban is too absolute; Singleton still has valid uses.
Wrong: newing many splits shared state (inventory/balance) into inconsistent copies.
why: 看部署,别为单例而单例。稳的答法:「一台物理机逻辑上一个实例;是否用 Singleton 取决于部署——我倾向依赖注入一个实例,因为单元测试和『一个进程模拟多台机器』时,单例反而碍事。」区分「逻辑唯一」与「Singleton 模式」比死记结论更显成熟。
why_en: It depends on deployment — do not use Singleton for its own sake. A solid answer: "one physical machine is logically one instance; whether to use Singleton depends on deployment — I prefer injecting a single instance, since Singleton gets in the way of unit tests and simulating many machines in one process." Separating "logically unique" from "the Singleton pattern" reads as more mature.
tradeoff: Singleton(全局唯一·省传参·难测/难多实例) vs DI 注入一个实例(唯一·可测·可多机模拟)

termDefinitions.meaning: 保证一个类全局只有一个实例并提供全局访问点。好处是共享状态唯一;坏处是全局状态难测(测试间会串)、难替换、掩盖依赖。现代做法常改用「依赖注入一个实例」替代硬 Singleton
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Singleton: guarantees one global instance of a class with a global access point. Pro: a single shared state; con: global state is hard to test (leaks between tests), hard to replace, and hides dependencies. Modern practice often injects a single instance instead of a hard Singleton.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对象需要的依赖(如那唯一的 VendingMachine 实例)由外部传入,而不是自己 new/自己找。好处:可在测试里换成 mock、可灵活配置多个实例,是替代硬 Singleton 的常用手段
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dependency injection: an object receives its dependencies (e.g. the one VendingMachine instance) from outside instead of newing/locating them itself. Benefits: swap in mocks for tests, configure multiple instances flexibly — the common alternative to a hard Singleton.

scenario: Follow-up：用户投了钱但机器没零钱找、或中途想取消，怎么设计？
scenario_en: Follow-up: the user paid but the machine cannot make change, or wants to cancel — how do you design it?
q: 怎么把「找零不足」和「取消退款」纳入设计？
q_en: How do you fold "insufficient change" and "cancel/refund" into the design?
options: 选货前先校验能否找开零钱，不能就拒绝该商品；Cancel 作为各状态自行决定是否支持的事件
无论零钱是否够找，都先把用户的钱收下、把商品出掉，找零和退款一律留到下一位用户来时再统一处理
一旦投币就禁止取消，钱一律不退
把找零和取消逻辑全硬编码进一个大 if
options_en: Validate change availability before selection; if impossible, reject that item; Cancel is an event each state decides whether to support
Regardless of whether change is available, take the user's money and dispense first, deferring all change and refunds until the next user arrives
Once money is inserted, forbid cancellation and never refund
Hard-code all change and cancel logic into one big if
optionExplanations: 对：找零可行性是「选货前的前置校验」,Cancel/退款是「状态相关事件」(HasMoney 可退、Dispensing 一般不可)——都自然落进状态机。
错：钱收了却可能找不开零钱,把问题甩给下一个用户,体验和账务都崩。
错：不给退款既不合理也不合规,HasMoney 下本应能退。
错：大 if 又回到反模式,退款应是 State 接口的一个事件。
optionExplanations_en: Right: change feasibility is a pre-check before selection; Cancel/refund is a state-dependent event (refundable in HasMoney, usually not in Dispensing) — both fall naturally into the state machine.
Wrong: taking money you may not be able to change and dumping it on the next user breaks UX and accounting.
Wrong: no refund is unreasonable and non-compliant; HasMoney should allow it.
Wrong: a big if is the anti-pattern again; refund should be an event on the State interface.
why: 状态+校验组合:①选货前先校验能否找开零钱(按硬币面额),不够就拒绝该商品;②Cancel 是各状态自行决定是否支持的事件——HasMoney 下 cancel→退币→回 Idle,Dispensing 下一般不允许。把 refund 做成 State 接口的一个事件。ATM 的「余额不足」同理:Authenticated 里 withdraw 前校验 account.balance。
why_en: A state + validation combo: (1) before selection, check whether change can be made (by coin denominations) and reject the item if not; (2) Cancel is an event each state decides — in HasMoney cancel→refund coins→Idle, usually disallowed in Dispensing. Make refund an event on the State interface. The ATM's "insufficient funds" is analogous: validate account.balance before withdraw in Authenticated.

scenario: Follow-up：ATM 现在要加「转账」和「改密码」，改动多大？
scenario_en: Follow-up: the ATM must add "transfer" and "change PIN" — how big is the change?
q: 最符合 OCP、又满足审计的做法是？
q_en: What best fits OCP while satisfying auditing?
options: 每种交易做成 Transaction 子类实现 execute(account)，Authenticated 持有交易列表，每笔落一条审计记录
在 ATM 的 Authenticated 状态里不断加 if txn=="transfer"/"changePin" 的新分支，每加一种交易就回来改这段分派代码
为转账和改密码各写一个全新的 ATM 类
直接在按钮回调里写转账逻辑，不记录任何日志
options_en: Make each transaction a Transaction subclass implementing execute(account); Authenticated holds a list of them; each writes an audit record
Keep adding if txn=="transfer"/"changePin" branches inside the ATM's Authenticated state, editing that dispatch code for every new transaction
Write a brand-new ATM class for transfer and for change-PIN
Write transfer logic directly in the button callback and log nothing
optionExplanations: 对：交易即插件(Transaction 子类实现 execute),加类型=加类;每笔落审计记录满足对账/合规。
错：往 Authenticated 里加 if 就是每次改老代码,违反 OCP。
错：为每种交易复制整个 ATM 类是极端重复。
错：不记日志在金融场景不可接受,审计是硬要求。
optionExplanations_en: Right: transactions are pluggable (Transaction subclasses implement execute); adding a type = adding a class; each writes an audit record for reconciliation/compliance.
Wrong: adding ifs in Authenticated edits old code every time — breaks OCP.
Wrong: copying the whole ATM class per transaction is extreme duplication.
Wrong: logging nothing is unacceptable in finance; auditing is a hard requirement.
why: OCP:每种交易做成 Transaction 子类(Withdraw/Deposit/Transfer/ChangePin),实现 execute(account)。ATM 的 Authenticated 状态持有交易列表,加类型=加子类,状态机不动。每笔 execute 落一条 TransactionRecord(审计日志),支持对账/回溯——Amazon 很爱追审计与合规。
why_en: OCP: each transaction is a Transaction subclass (Withdraw/Deposit/Transfer/ChangePin) implementing execute(account). The ATM's Authenticated state holds a list; adding a type = adding a subclass, the state machine unchanged. Each execute writes a TransactionRecord (audit log) for reconciliation/traceability — Amazon loves probing auditing and compliance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把每一笔业务操作(谁、何时、做了什么、结果)不可变地记一条,用于事后对账、合规、排障、追责。金融/交易类系统的硬需求;设计时要预留「每笔操作落一条记录」
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An audit log immutably records every business operation (who, when, what, outcome) for later reconciliation, compliance, debugging, and accountability. A hard requirement in finance/transaction systems; design so every operation writes one record.

scenario: Follow-up：这个状态机你怎么写单元测试？
scenario_en: Follow-up: how do you unit-test this state machine?
q: 最能体现状态模式可测性的测试策略是？
q_en: Which testing strategy best shows the State pattern's testability?
options: 每个状态类单独测(事件→新状态/数据/异常)，再测完整路径，用 mock 支付和库存测失败分支
把整台机器的完整程序都启动起来，靠人工一个按钮一个按钮地手动点，逐个场景反复用肉眼确认结果对不对
只测最终能不能出货，不管中间状态对不对
因为逻辑分散在很多类里，根本没法写单元测试
options_en: Test each state class in isolation (event→new state/data/exception), then whole paths, using mock payment and inventory for failure branches
Boot the machine's entire program and manually click one button after another, eyeballing every scenario by hand to see if the result is right
Only test whether it eventually dispenses, ignoring intermediate states
Because logic is spread across many classes, unit tests are impossible
optionExplanations: 对：状态逻辑分散在小类里,每个都是好测的纯单元;再补端到端路径 + mock 失败分支——正是 State 相对大 if 的测试优势。
错：纯手动点不可重复、不可回归,不是单元测试。
错：只看终态会漏掉非法转移、错误处理等中间 bug。
错：恰恰相反,解耦成小类让单测更好写。
optionExplanations_en: Right: state logic lives in small classes, each an easily testable pure unit; add end-to-end paths + mocked failure branches — exactly the State advantage over a big if.
Wrong: pure manual clicking is not repeatable or regressable; not unit testing.
Wrong: only checking the final state misses illegal transitions and error-handling bugs.
Wrong: on the contrary, decoupling into small classes makes unit tests easier.
why: 三层:①每个状态类单独测——给 machine+事件,断言「新状态对不对、数据变没变、非法操作有没有抛错」;②测完整路径(投币→选货→出货→回 Idle);③用 mock 支付/库存测失败分支(支付失败、售罄)。状态逻辑分散在小类里、每个都是纯单元——这正是状态模式相对大 if 的可测性优势。
why_en: Three layers: (1) test each state class in isolation — given machine+event, assert the new state, data change, and that illegal actions throw; (2) test whole paths (insert→select→dispense→Idle); (3) mock payment/inventory to test failure branches (payment fail, sold out). State logic in small pure units is the State pattern's testability edge over a big if.

termDefinitions.meaning: 测试里用一个「假的」替身对象顶替真实依赖(如真实支付网关、真实库存),让你能精确制造成功/失败/超时等分支、不依赖外部系统。是隔离单元、测异常路径的常用手段
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mock is a fake stand-in object replacing a real dependency (e.g. a real payment gateway or inventory) so you can precisely force success/failure/timeout branches without external systems. A common way to isolate a unit and test error paths.

scenario: Follow-up：状态和事件组合越来越多，类会不会爆炸？
scenario_en: Follow-up: as states and events grow, will classes explode?
q: 控制状态爆炸的正确手段有？（多选）
q_en: Which are valid ways to control state explosion? (multi-select)
options: 用层次状态机(HSM)把相关状态归组、共享父状态的默认行为
状态多但每态行为简单时，改用数据驱动的 (state,event)→state 转移表
承认状态模式有边界，按规模在「状态对象」和「转移表」之间做选择
无脑给每一种「状态×事件×时间」的组合都单独建一个新类，认为类建得越多、设计就越严谨越好
options_en: Use a hierarchical state machine (HSM) to group related states and share the parent's default behavior
When states are many but per-state behavior is simple, switch to a data-driven (state,event)→state transition table
Accept that the State pattern has limits and choose between state objects and a transition table by scale
Blindly create a separate class for every state×event×time combination, believing the more classes you make the more rigorous the design
optionExplanations: 对：HSM 让相关状态共享父行为,砍掉重复。
对：转移规整、行为轻时,转移表比每态一类更省。
对：知道状态模式的边界、按规模选型,正是成熟判断。
错：为每种组合都建类才是真正的类爆炸,方向反了。
optionExplanations_en: Right: an HSM lets related states share parent behavior, cutting duplication.
Right: when transitions are regular and behavior light, a table beats one class per state.
Right: knowing the pattern's limits and choosing by scale is the mature judgment.
Wrong: a class per combination is the actual explosion — the opposite direction.
why: 两个手段+承认边界:①层次状态机(HSM):相关状态归组(如「运营中」下再分 Idle/HasMoney),共享父状态默认行为;②状态多但每态行为简单时,退回数据驱动的 (state,event)→state 转移表,不必每态一类。知道状态模式不是银弹、说得出它的边界,本身就是加分点。
why_en: Two tools + owning the limits: (1) a hierarchical state machine (HSM) groups related states (e.g. "Operating" splits into Idle/HasMoney) sharing the parent's default behavior; (2) when states are many but behavior is simple, fall back to a data-driven (state,event)→state table instead of one class per state. Knowing the State pattern is not a silver bullet — and naming its limits — scores points.
tradeoff: 状态对象(行为复杂·类多) vs 转移表(行为简单规整·数据驱动·省类)

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许状态嵌套:子状态自动继承父状态的默认转移/行为,只覆盖自己特殊的部分。用来消除「很多状态对同一事件都做同样反应」的重复,是应对状态爆炸的经典手段(UML statechart 的核心)
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hierarchical state machine allows nested states: a substate inherits the parent's default transitions/behavior and overrides only its specifics. It removes duplication when many states react the same way to an event — a classic remedy for state explosion (core of UML statecharts).
